root_causes.root_cause: _garble_ratio full-text check mirrors _tree_is_garbled — windowed ratio is dead code, always returns 1.0. In classify_verdict, _tree_is_garbled(structure) (line 1559) calls _is_garbled_blob+_has_sparse_mojibake on _flatten_tree_text(structure). When True, _garble_ratio(flat_text) (line 1572) evaluates the SAME checks on the SAME text, so full_garbled=1.0 and max(1.0, window_ratio)=1.0 always. The windowed ratio (designed for fine-grained measurement) never influences the result. For the SLA doc, _has_sparse_mojibake fires on the full concatenated text because _flatten_tree_text joins titles+text with NO separator (line 555-565), creating artificial Arabic-Latin-Arabic glued patterns at node boundaries. The doc is at the 2% threshold boundary — minor extraction differences between runs push it over/under, flipping full_garbled between 0.0 and 1.0 (PASS vs MARGINAL with ratio=1.00).
root_causes.suggested_fix: Remove the full-text binary check from _garble_ratio. The function should ONLY compute the windowed ratio (chunks approach). _tree_is_garbled already gates entry into the garble-ratio path in classify_verdict, so the full-text check in _garble_ratio is redundant and harmful. Additionally, _flatten_tree_text should insert a space or newline separator between concatenated parts to prevent artificial glued-script patterns.

root_causes.root_cause: Garble gate blind to non-PUA Arabic single-letter fragment decomposition; bidi coherence enforcement disabled. _is_garbled_blob has no heuristic for single-letter Arabic fragment patterns (letters separated by spaces, e.g. Arabic word decomposed into individual letters with spaces between them). This is a common PDF text-layer extraction failure. _check_bidi_coherence was wired into validate_tree by RFC-030 D5 but runs in audit-only mode (BIDI_COHERENCE_ENFORCE defaults to false, line 1288). It logs warnings but does not affect the stored verdict. Combined: سياسة حوكمة passes the gate with stored verdict PASS despite 79% of nodes containing garbled single-letter fragments and RTL word-order reversal, because neither pattern is detected by the enforced checks.
root_causes.suggested_fix: (a) Add a single-letter Arabic fragment detection heuristic to _is_garbled_blob: when >50% of Arabic words in a blob are single characters (excluding particles like و), flag as garbled. (b) Promote BIDI_COHERENCE_ENFORCE from audit-only to enforced (default true) after reviewing the accumulated audit logs for false-positive rate. (c) Add the single-letter-fragment check to _garble_check_nodes per-node inspection as well.
